sources.snippet: * Janod is in the US! Suitable for use from 12 months, this toy is like a jigsaw puzzle. A perfect early-learning toy for developing your baby's sense of observation and fine motor skills. With this wooden toddler toy, you're sure to keep baby busy for a long time with a durable, fun game. This tractor hide-and-seek is made of wood from sustainably managed forests. From 12 months, your baby will love his pull-along train. With 3 wagons and 19 parts to assemble, this wooden train is both a construction game and a pull-along toy that encourages movement. In the playful, colorful world of the farm, your baby will be delighted to discover little animals (a white rabbit, a brown rabbit and a little hen), as well as fun vegetables (potato, tomato, carrot and radish). Ideal for baby's first steps and big adventures, it's suitable for little ones from 12 months of age.
